_readme: TMP_009 iteration 16 — DEPTH MODE ControlNet. Iter 15 (canny open-arc) achieved FIRST V=2 clean (snow s303) but multi-pom + substrate-disc failure modes persisted (6/9). Diagnosis: canny = edge control (model fills inside freely → trained-prior multi-pom). Switch to DEPTH = volume control (object volume at the depth-map location). Hint = filled white dome on black (uniform near-foreground depth). xinsir union-promax model unchanged — same model supports both modes via SetUnionControlNetType. Single logical variable: canny→depth. Strength/timing/everything else verbatim iter 15.
